### A Precious Love Letter
Author: Tope Keku
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/beloved-women/beloved-women-july-23-2020.html
Passage: Jeremiah 15:16
Points:
- Cherished love letters remind us of the deep excitement of being chosen and treasured.
- Scripture functions as God's personal love letter to His children.
- Approaching the Bible with intentionality turns God's Word into our daily joy and delight.
- Ingesting God's truth allows it to penetrate our hearts and guide our attitudes and actions.
- Meditating on God's abundant grace deepens our intimate walk with Him.

### Bible Pathways - Aug. 18, 2008
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-aug-18-2008-11580597.html
Passage: Jeremiah 15:15-16
Points:
- Amid intense rejection and suffering, Jeremiah found comfort and honor in God's promises.
- Believers frequently devote hours to secular entertainment while ignoring God's Word.
- Scripture must not remain mere intellectual theory; it must be personally ingested and experienced.
- Neglecting regular feeding on God's Word signals spiritual sickness and decay.
- Taking in God's truth serves as vital nourishment that fills the soul with enduring joy.
